detail.longDescription: AquaTrace v0.6.1 is out! 💧🚴🥾 Using the recently added logging for failed GPX imports, I identified and fixed compatibility issues affecting certain GPX files that were previously rejected by AquaTrace. A small technical note: it seems that some Samsung Health GPX exports are not fully compliant with the GPX 1.1 schema. AquaTrace is now more tolerant of these files. Try it here: https:// aquatrace.uggla.fr # OpenSource # Rust # TypeScript # GPX # Cycling # Hiking # OpenStreetMap
